resources.string: Start Touchpad on the PC and use the same Wi-Fi.
The phone and the PC will both forget each other. To use the touchpad again you will need to pair again.
Start Touchpad on your PC. It accepts new phones for 5 minutes after its first start, or after you choose Pair a new phone from its icon by the clock.
Looking for PCs on this Wi-Fi…
Not accepting phones: choose Pair a new phone on the PC

If the codes are different, tap Cancel: another device may be trying to intercept the connection.
On %1$s, click Yes in the pairing box (or type y in the server window).
The PC isn\'t accepting new phones right now. Choose Pair a new phone on the PC, then try again.
